run_do_rollout: run a single-core rollout to sample trajectories from a policy in a Gym environment
run_sample_paths: sample trajectories from a policy using single or multi-core parallel rollout across CPUs
run_sample_data_batch: sample a fixed number of data points by repeatedly collecting trajectories until the target count is reached
review_do_rollout: review the do_rollout function that collects observations, actions, rewards, and infos per trajectory episode
refactor_sample_paths: refactor sample_paths to adjust the multiprocessing strategy or timeout handling for trajectory collection
